item.title: 820,000 Sogo members at risk as department store, Chow Sang Sang hit by data breaches
item.description: Major Hong Kong retailers Sogo and Chow Sang Sang have disclosed separate data breaches after unauthorised parties accessed their systems, potentially exposing the personal information of customers, including that of up to 820,000 Sogo loyalty members. item.title: Suspect shoots himself after killing 1 and wounding 4 in Washington
item.description: A man in a long-running dispute over the conditions of his penthouse flat gunned down the building manager in a busy gym on Thursday before fleeing and shooting four more people from his patio, shocking a popular Washington neighbourhood and attracting a swarm of police officers. item.title: ‘Constant fear’: lung patient’s long wait for transplant highlights urgent need
item.description: Raymond, 66, lived in constant fear of becoming a burden to his family in recent years as his lung disease, diagnosed 16 years ago, worsened, and he needed an organ transplant to survive. The pulmonary fibrosis patient said on Thursday that he had waited to receive a lung transplant for more than two years after being placed on the waiting list in 2023. item.title: Megaspeed ex-CEO Alice Huang barred from Singapore amid Nvidia saga
item.description: Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, accused by the US of being a Chinese spy and linked to an extramarital affair with tech giant Nvidia’s co-founder Jensen Huang, has been barred from re-entering Singapore over inaccurate information provided to police.
